descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks - You produce and prepare appealing menus. - You advise and serve our guests as the first point of contact. - You provide support with ordering groceries.
• What you bring to the table - Ability to work in a team and enjoy contact with people - Organisational skills and flexibility - Willingness to work independently and take on responsibilities - Enjoyment of developing in a dynamic company - Interest in food - Enjoyment of dealing with guests
• What we offer you - Annual subscription "update Fitness" - CHF 500 for laptop or tablet - 50% off first mobile plan from Coop Mobile - SBB Half-Fare travelcard or GA travelcard portion CHF 650 - Many discounts for Employees Prisca Mognetti HR Vocational Training Choose Your Character - Create Your Future: Shape your future with a suitable apprenticeship. Coop offers a wide range of apprenticeships and further training opportunities.
